messages.author: ieb
messages.text:
Instead of applying the 15% fee when loaning above 70%, It might be better to add a 20% one that only applies to the section above the 70% mark. This to me feels like a more logical way to apply the fee, and still slightly discourage higher loan amounts.

With these current numbers for loans at max capacity the fee will end up being relatively cheaper, but loans closer to the line are not as punishing in the cost increase. Allowing for slightly more freedom in choosing how much to loan.
